posts.post:
the guy at the dinner party who refuses to take his sunglasses off, even inside.

it’s never as cool as you think it is.
does a clean fit matter if you’re still checking your reflection in every window you pass?

the pockets on your trousers are for keys and a wallet.

stop overstuffing them until you look like you’re carrying a toolkit.
the fabric we sourced for the latest batch felt incredible, then we washed it and it lost all its character. back to the drawing board.
